Phương thức vận tải hàng hóa bằng đường.zh: 由铁路运输货物的方法具有主要的中转能力,在长途航道上进行运输,包括大型载货. 评分低于陆路运输,如在650公里(6.5升)的燃料距离上运输一吨货物.

Theo chỉ dẫn của Google Maps, nếu chạy t.en: According to Google Maps' instructions, if followed Route 13, the distance that moved from the Cultural to the West of France was approximately 1,508 km (5.08 km) long, equivalent to about 27 hours. So the time for shipping from the Yuan to the Western Kingdom took about 4 – 5 days.
Theo chỉ dẫn của Google Maps, nếu chạy t.zh: 根据Google Maps的指示,如果遵循13号公路,从"文化"向法国西部移动的距离约为1,508公里(5.08公里)长,相当于约27小时. 因此从元朝到西域的通航时间大约需要4—5天.

Thái Nguyên có mạng lưới giao thông thuậ.en: The Yuan has a convenient traffic network that connects to provinces in both the country and the international. At the same time, there's an important traffic stop on railroads, roads, rivers. Some of the highways run through like Highway 3, Highway 1B, Route 37... and invest in the construction of the 5th perimeter line with the highways, creating a cross-transference of the transport; the Cultural Railway – The Seas – Laos Cai – The Daoshan and the Northern Railroad – The South are the bridge for the trade operation.
Thái Nguyên có mạng lưới giao thông thuậ.zh: 元有通畅交通网,与国内外各省相接. 同时在铁路,公路,河流上也设有重要的交通站. 有的高速公路有"3号高速公路","1B高速公路","37号公路"等通车. 并投资建设了与高速公路相接的5号环线,形成了交通的交接;"文化铁路"-"海洋"-"老挝"-"道山"和"北方铁路"-"南方"是通商业务的桥梁.

Thái Nguyên là một trong những tỉnh tâm.en: The Yuan is one of the provinces of the Middle East Mountain area. The entire province has nine administrative units, 6 districts and 178 socials. The terrain is not too complex, the mild climate is the favorable conditions for the Thai Party to develop agriculture, forestry, industry. The mineral resources are particularly rich in development of mining industry, ironwork... the first of the country's water in terms of coal reserves, of very potential building materials, besides gold, copper, mercury, zinc...
Thái Nguyên là một trong những tỉnh tâm.zh: 元为中山地区所辖道之一. 全省下辖9个行政单位,6个区和178个社. 地势并不太复杂,温和的气候是泰国党发展农业,林业,工业的有利条件. 矿产资源特别丰富 发展采矿业,铁道... 从煤炭储量来看,是全国第一种水,除了黄金,铜,汞,锌之外,还有非常有潜力的建筑材料......
